description: The app's alerts, as its panel shows them: what needs the developer now (store full with its 7-day countdown, their own database not answering, payments waiting for it, a data migration paused for the quota, quota out or in its 10 % margin, users saving in a loop, formal legal notices on community entries, the community put on hold by Neblla, data erasure requests, reviews without an answer, a failed "Move to pro" batch, automatic recharges done or failed) and the history (90 days). Each alert says in plain words what happens (`text.what`), what the users notice (`text.users`) and what to do or who has to look at it (`text.todo`). "list" { lang?, topic?, history? } → { attention, history, counts }; "settings" → per alert type who gets it (`to`: "owner" or team emails, from neblla_team) and where (`via`: "email", "slack", "discord"; the panel always has it), and whether a Slack / Discord webhook is set. Changes nothing; neblla_alerts dismisses, sets and tests.
name: neblla_alerts_read
title: Alerts (read)
